tagline: One conversation instead of four government visits
beneficiary: Omar Haddad, a bakery owner in Deira who moved his shop to Al Quoz. His trade license expires in 20 days, and his last renewal was rejected because a supporting certificate had quietly expired.
claim: Turns four department visits and one rejection cycle into one confirmed conversation, and catches the rejection before submission.
what_it_does: Reads the uploaded Emirates ID, trade license, Ejari and tax certificate with Amazon Textract
Flags the expired tax clearance and the Deira-to-Al Quoz address mismatch before anything is filed
Sequences the linked services in dependency order from the policy Knowledge Base: tax clearance, address change, license renewal
Asks for consent, then submits all three across departments and returns tracking ids and dates
Tracks status, flags overdue applications and notifies Omar in Arabic
architecture_note: Kiro-built Strands agent on AgentCore Runtime with Claude Sonnet 4.5 on Bedrock and the baseline Guardrail. Eight tools run as a Lambda behind AgentCore Gateway (JWT via Cognito): Textract extraction with validity flags, Knowledge Base retrieval, DynamoDB services and applications, SNS plus Amazon Translate notifications. AgentCore Memory keeps citizen preferences. Traces in CloudWatch GenAI Observability.
demo_steps: Omar signs in to the Arabic right-to-left UI and asks to renew his license and update his address
Agent reads four documents, finds the expired tax clearance and the address mismatch
Agent proposes three services in order, 170 AED, 12 business days, and asks for consent
Omar confirms; agent submits across three departments and returns three tracking ids
Trace shows 12 autonomous tool calls; a request to backdate the certificate is refused
impact: Customer impact: one named business owner, zero wasted trips, rejection prevented before filing
Agentic depth: one request, 12 tool calls across Textract, Knowledge Base, DynamoDB, SNS, Translate
Regional relevance: Ejari and trade-license flow, Arabic replies, right-to-left interface
Honest limits: departments and submissions are mocked in DynamoDB; documents are synthetic
next_steps: UAE Pass sign-in and real DET, Ejari and FTA APIs behind the same Gateway tools
Proactive follow-up: memory-driven status checks and reminders before expiry dates
Cedar policies on the Gateway so submit_application is only allowed after a confirmation event
Evaluations that score 'verified requirements before submitting' on every session
